summary: Frontend-only UI-structure verification for Shopify Headless prep on /menu, ProductDetail modal, TreatDetail modal, and CartDrawer. All 12 requested feature areas PASS. Variant pills and personalization radios correctly do NOT change price or quantity. No gold badges present. Cart discount messaging + tier math all correct.

verified_features.treat_variant_click_does_not_change_pric: treat-price='$11.99' before and after treat-variant-2 click

critical_code_review_comments: BoxBuilder.js is 1193 lines — still exceeds the 700-line threshold; consider splitting ProductCard, MenuFunnel, and TreatDetailModal wrappers into separate files.
CartAndCheckout.js is 1438 lines — houses CartDrawer, TreatsSection, CheckoutForm, address autocomplete, etc. Should be split into per-component files for maintainability.

ProductDetail.js and TreatDetail.js both duplicate the DISCOUNT_RATES constant ({0/6:0,12/18:0.05,24:0.10,36:0.15}). Also, TreatDetail uses `{ 6: 0, 18: 0.05, ... }` while others use `{0:0, 12:0.05,...}` — divergent tier definitions across files; centralise in a shared constants module.

VARIANT_OPTIONS and PERSONALIZATION_OPTIONS are hard-coded module-level arrays in ProductDetail.js / TreatDetail.js. When Shopify variant binding lands, these must be lifted to fetched variant data — safe to leave as visual placeholders per this iteration's spec.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded products (cd-chicken meal, treat-beef-ribs treat). All state cleared from sessionStorage between runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To reproduce: clear sessionStorage → reload /menu → click [data-testid='funnel-shop-raw'] → the menu appears. Test IDs verified: funnel-shop-raw, menu-category-tabs, category-{dog|cat}-{food|treats}, product-<id>, add/decrease/qty/increase-<id>, cart-button, cart-drawer, cart-discount-info, cart-meal-lbs, cart-discount-applied, cart-discount-next, product-modal-overlay, product-price, product-add-to-box (label switches 'Add to Basket'/'Update Basket'), product-personalizations, personalization-0/1, product-variants, variant-0/1 ('1 lb'/'1.5 lb'), qty-decrease/qty-display/qty-increase; treat-modal-overlay, treat-price, treat-add-to-box, treat-personalizations, treat-variants, treat-variant-0/1/2 ('1 pack'/'3 pack'/'5 pack'), treat-qty-decrease/treat-qty/treat-qty-increase. IMPORTANT for regression: variant + personalization clicks intentionally do NOT change price/qty — do not flag as bug.
rca of the issue: No functional issues found. The spec's 'From $X.XX/lb' string renders with CSS text-transform:uppercase so the DOM text reads 'FROM $3.82 /lb' — this is the expected implementation and matches the visible design language.
